about:
330 Electronics, LLC operates from Buckner, Kentucky, providing electronics manufacturing services to OEMs and engineering teams. The company delivers responsive support, consistent quality, and predictable lead times without the constraints of high-volume manufacturers.

The company specializes in flexible PCB assembly, offering surface-mount, through-hole, mixed-technology, and selective or hand soldering. It also provides box-build integration, sub-assembly, cable and harness integration, product packaging, fulfillment, and full turnkey material procurement. 330 Electronics focuses on low-volume, high-mix production, supporting runs from prototype through mid-volume, and designs and manufactures custom temperature control systems with UL-listed solutions.

330 Electronics serves OEM manufacturers, engineering and product development teams, and operations and supply chain leaders. Its customer base includes companies in automotive electronics and renewable energy sectors, as well as organizations seeking a domestic manufacturing partner to reduce supply chain complexity.

The company emphasizes reliable production support, responsive partnership, U.S.-based manufacturing for improved visibility and shorter communication cycles, an engineering-focused approach to simplify development-to-production transitions, scalable solutions, and a disciplined quality approach that integrates visual inspection, functional testing, and controlled processes throughout manufacturing.
